rubric: Frozen neutral rubric; applicability separate from truth, stance, quality and final policy.
method: Read only annotation-inputs.json, sources.json and rubric.md. No build.py, author labels, README counts, candidate adapter prompt/code or new provider outputs read. Generic provenance mechanism and proposed scope wording were reviewed earlier; this familiarity is disclosed. Packet category/partition fields were visible but no expected labels were supplied. No source browsing.
